style: Mobile game sound effect, cute and punchy with a slightly eerie Korean ghost-story mood. Clean and dry, no background noise, no music, no speech.

sounds.text: Short soft punchy thud of a small hit landing on a squishy cartoon ghost, quick and dry.
Heavier punchy impact thud with a little magical sparkle on top, cartoon game hit.
Critical hit: a sharp bright metallic 'ting' over a crisp punchy impact.
Deep dull heavy thump of hitting a huge monster, low and weighty.
Dull soft thud of a small cute character getting hit, with a tiny squeak.
Bright glassy 'clink' of an attack bouncing off a magic shield.
Quick light sword swing whoosh.
Low heavy swing whoosh of a big shield.
Small magic bolt being cast: a soft airy 'fwoom' with a little sparkle.
Tiny gentle healing chime, one soft bell sparkle.
A cute ghost hero pops onto the battlefield: a quick rising whoosh ending in a bouncy 'pop'.
A small character quickly vanishing: a short soft downward whip and a puff of air.
Picking up a paper card: a light paper slide with a soft click.
Soft bright notification that a card is ready: two quick rising bell notes.
Perfect dodge success: a sharp sparkling 'shing', a bright rising chime and a short slow-motion whoosh. Satisfying and heroic.
Eerie short warning that a monster is about to appear: a low ghostly whisper swell with one tiny spooky bell.
A small spooky monster is defeated: a quick soft puff of smoke with a tiny ghostly squeal fading away.
A monster winding up an attack: a short tense rising growl and whoosh.
Soft clean button tap, a tiny wooden click.
Short victory sting for clearing a floor in a cute ghost-story mobile game: a bright cheerful chime flourish with a faint eerie twinkle at the end. No speech.
